hardwareHubs.note: FirstBuild runs a makerspace and a microfactory in Louisville and works with GE Appliances on home products.

makerspaces.name: FirstBuild Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Members can reserve tools and take classes in 3D printing, laser cutting, CAD and soldering.

support.name: Kentucky Manufacturing Extension Partnership (KMEP)
support.note: University of Louisville hosts the state's MEP center, announced in December 2022, to help manufacturers raise productivity and enter new markets.
